plan: A: Nuxt frontend + existing Flask backend on Vercel Services
notes: Phase 1 runs Nuxt with ssr: false (SPA). Browser calls /api/* as today, so vercel.json rewrites and Flask stay the same.
Phase 2 (optional) turns on SSR/hybrid for some pages. Server-side fetches cannot use relative /api, so they need a Vercel service binding URL.
Only set passes to true after running every step in that feature and seeing it work.
Backend tests: cd backend && pytest. They must stay green for every feature.

features.description: Replace the Vite + Vue app in frontend/ with a Nuxt app that has ssr: false
steps: Scaffold Nuxt into frontend/ (keep the folder name so vercel.json root stays frontend/)
Set ssr: false in nuxt.config.ts
Remove Vite-only files: index.html, vite.config.ts, src/main.ts, env.d.ts, tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.node.json
Make .gitignore cover .nuxt/ and .output/
Run npm run dev and see the default Nuxt page at http://localhost:3000

features.description: Proxy /api to Flask in local dev
steps: Add a dev proxy for /api in nuxt.config.ts that targets process.env.API_PROXY_TARGET ?? 'http://localhost:5000'
Start Flask (cd backend && python app.py) and Nuxt (npm run dev) in two terminals
Open http://localhost:3000/api/health and get {"status":"ok"}
Add @nuxtjs/tailwindcss (or the Tailwind setup Nuxt docs recommend) and move tailwind.config.js content paths to Nuxt folders
Put a Tailwind class on a page and see it styled in the browser

features.description: Port shared types and the API client
steps: Move src/types.ts to frontend/types.ts (or utils/) and keep Game, CURRENCIES, Currency unchanged
Move src/api/games.ts to a Nuxt utils/ or composables/ file; keep the relative /api/search URL
Run npx nuxi typecheck with no errors
Move both .vue files to frontend/components/ (Nuxt auto-imports them, so remove manual imports)
Check GameCard still opens dealUrl in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer"
Check CurrencySelect still works with v-model (defineModel)

features.description: Search page at / behaves the same as the current App.vue
steps: Create pages/index.vue with the search input, currency select, debounce 500 ms and AbortController logic from App.vue
Type a game name and see results after the debounce
Change currency and see prices update
Search for nonsense text and see the empty state
Stop Flask and see the error state instead of a blank page
Type fast and confirm older requests are aborted (Network tab shows canceled)

features.description: Shared layout and a second page to prove multi-page routing
steps: Create layouts/default.vue with a header and nav links (NuxtLink) to / and /about
Create pages/about.vue that explains the data sources (CheapShark, exchange rate API)
Click between pages and confirm no full page reload
Open /about directly in a new tab and confirm it loads (SPA fallback works)
Use useHead (or useSeoMeta) on each page instead of setting document.title by hand
Confirm the tab title changes on / , /about and while searching

features.description: Docker Compose still works for local dev
steps: Update frontend/Dockerfile to run the Nuxt dev server on 0.0.0.0:3000
Change the frontend port mapping in docker-compose.yml from 5173 to 3000
Run docker compose up --build and search a game at http://localhost:3000

features.description: Deploy Nuxt + Flask on Vercel Services
steps: In vercel.json change services.web.framework from vite to Nuxt (check the exact slug in Vercel docs, or remove the key so Vercel auto-detects)
Keep the api service and both rewrites unchanged
Push a branch and open the Vercel preview URL
Confirm /, /about and /api/health all work on the preview
Merge to main and confirm production works
Update the structure section, local run commands (port 3000) and deploy notes
Follow the README from a clean clone and confirm it works

features.description: Optional: enable SSR or hybrid rendering for selected pages
steps: Set ssr: true and use routeRules, for example '/about': { prerender: true }
Keep the search page client-only, because results depend on user input
Run npm run build and confirm /about is prerendered in .output/public

features.description: Optional: server-side fetch from Flask via a Vercel service binding
steps: Add a service binding so the web service gets the api service URL as an env var
Read that URL through runtimeConfig in nuxt.config.ts; never hardcode it
Use it only for fetches that run on the server (useFetch during SSR); browser fetches keep using /api
Deploy a preview and confirm an SSR page renders data with JavaScript disabled
